hints.title: Subarray Sum Divisibility
hints.text: A subarray has sum divisible by k if and only if the cumulative sums at its endpoints share identical remainders modulo k.

hints.title: Prefix Remainder Memoization
hints.text: Maintain the minimal remaining cost previously achieved for each remainder state.

hints.title: Dynamic State Transition
hints.text: For each element, either retain the current value or drop the contiguous block ending here if a matching remainder was seen.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def minSum(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        # dp[i]: minimum sum of remaining elements from prefix nums[0..i]
        # Best dp value for each prefix_sum % k
        # best[rem] stores min(dp[j] - prefix_sum[j])
        
        prefix = 0
        dp = 0
        best = {0: 0}
        
        for x in nums:
            prefix += x
            rem = prefix % k
            dp += x
            if rem in best:
                dp = min(dp, best[rem])
            best[rem] = min(best.get(rem, float('inf')), dp)
            
        return dp
```

complexity.notes: Computes optimal deletion paths in a single pass using remainder hash map.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all candidate subarray deletion subsets requires exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses a map of size at most K to store best prefix costs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Connect modular arithmetic of prefix sums with 1D optimization.
